In [[mathematics]], a '''limit''' describes the behaviour of a [[function]] as the input approaches a certain value.

== Formal definition ==

Let $A,B$ be [[set]]s, and $d_A,d_B$ be the [[metric space#Formal_definition|metric functions]] of $A,B$.

Define [[function]]

$$
f: A \to B
$$

Then if

$$
\forall \epsilon > 0: \exists \delta \in \mathbb{R}, \ell \in B ,\, \\
\forall x \in A: d_A(x,x_0) < \delta \Rightarrow d_B(f(x),\ell) < \epsilon
$$

then

$$
\lim_{x \to x_0} = \ell
$$

<ref>{{#cite:Q2464}}</ref>
